name: mirror_status
description: Read Mirror's live revision and window metadata. Initial launch true may install the pinned GitHub preview if missing; macOS first-open remains manual. Follow-up checks use false to respect a human quit.

launch.description: Initial status may launch Mirror; follow-up checks use false.

request_id.description: UUID or null to generate one. Retain it and the original arguments after an uncertain result; never blindly retry a mutation.

name: mirror_open
description: Open or reuse a read-only reference to a confirmed local Codex conversation. Loading and binding are separate states; do not guess conversation IDs. Requires a fresh revision; human changes or paused control take priority. Sent once, never automatically retried.

conversation.description: Confirmed local Codex conversation ID; not a title or search string.

message.description: Actual TURN_ID/ITEM_ID, or null for no message target.

new.description: False reuses a unique reference; true explicitly requests an additional window.
